title: Review: jmap-client crate
notes:
Confidence: 15% chance of missed bug. Least confident: SSE streaming state machine (complex with chunk-boundary overlap logic). Uncertainty driven by: no live SSE server testing, UTF-8 split behavior at exact chunk boundaries. Would raise confidence with: integration test against a real chunked HTTP response with a codepoint split across chunks.
Maintainer risk: MEDIUM — main risks are: WebSocket connect timeout gap, SSE Content-Type validation missing, ClientError semver-locked to reqwest/tungstenite versions.
Idiom rating: ACCEPTABLE — code is generally idiomatic Rust; primary gap is the repeated auth injection pattern. No unsafe, no gratuitous clones, error handling is structured. Auth injection refactor is the main improvement.
Rust idiom confidence: 90% chance no missed issue. Least confident: lifetime elision correctness in auth_header return type. Uncertainty driven by: didn't run clippy directly during review.
